מציאות מדומה (VR) היא טכנולוגיה שמכניסה: Virtual reality (VR) is a technology that puts the user inside a 3D environment "as if they are really there". In architecture it lets you experience a space at 1:1 scale and understand proportions, flow and the feel of the space - before construction.
היתרון המרכזי הוא מעבר מ\"דמיון מתוך שרט: The main advantage is the move from "imagining from a drawing" to a real spatial experience. It makes it easier to spot in time: a narrow corridor, a window set too high, the wrong flow, sight lines, proportions and the overall feel of the space. When it is found early, the fix is faster and cheaper.
כי VR מפחית אי־הבנות, \"מיישר קו\" בין צ: Because VR reduces misunderstandings, "aligns" the design teams and the architect with the client, and shortens decision time. It is also a strong emotional experience that builds trust and confidence in design decisions.
כמעט בכל פרויקט שבו חשוב להבין חלל לפני: Almost any project where it matters to understand the space before it is built: apartments and private homes, offices, retail, lobbies, public buildings, and also development projects that combine design with sales and marketing.
כן. סיור VR (ובעיקר סיור מוכן מראש) הוא: Yes. A VR tour (especially a ready-made tour) is a great tool for presenting the proposed design to the client, showing the value of the project clearly and creating a "wow". It suits sales presentations, project marketing and demos.
אין צורך בידע מוקדם. המערכת פשוטה לתפעול: No prior knowledge is needed. The system is simple to use and comes with clear training, so new users can try a virtual tour easily. Of course, the more hours you spend in VR, the more comfortable it feels.
לא בהכרח. ניתן לבצע סיור דינמי גם מרחוק: Not necessarily. A dynamic tour can also be done remotely, joining from a computer, tablet or phone. Still, the full experience is inside the virtual space, wearing a VR headset.
סוג הסיור נגזר מצרכי הפרויקט. מטרתו העיק: The type of tour depends on the project's needs. A dynamic tour is mainly for architectural design in a virtual space, team collaboration, finding problems and more. A ready-made tour is mainly for presenting the proposed design to the client, to get a visual impression of the planned space before it is built.
תלוי בסוג הסיור. בסיור מודרך שעה עד שעתי: It depends on the type of tour. A guided tour takes one to two hours. In a ready-made tour the client sets the pace.

פגישת אישור בקנה מידה 1:1. הלקוח נכנס לא: A 1:1 approval meeting. The client walks into the space before it is built, at real size - not a presentation, they are standing inside - and decides from within VR: change a finish, swap furniture, move a window. No more "I didn't understand" and no more "I didn't see it". The decisions go back to your Revit file together with the approval record - not to anyone's cloud.
לא. ההחלטות נכתבות לעותק חדש של הקובץ (S: No. The decisions are written to a new copy of the file (Save As): the wall closes, the window moves and the approval record is saved - and the original stays exactly as it was. The model stays with you, in the office.
להיות שם - לראות, להרגיש, להחליט. מייצאי: Be there - see, feel, decide. Export the model from Revit and walk through it at 1:1 scale in a VR headset (or in the browser) - check the space and the materials before construction. No installation, free.
יצירה אוטומטית של משפחות רוויט דינמיות -: Automatic creation of dynamic Revit families - from a manufacturer's catalogue or a free description - straight to a real .rfa file that stays yours: parametric, measured, ready for the project. Every parameter moves real geometry (sizes, drawers, fronts, handles), and the parameters follow the BIM standard. No more building families by hand.
טיפוס חדש, בלי להקליד פרמטרים. בוחרים מש: A new type, without typing parameters. Pick a family already in the project, move sliders and see the change live in 3D - and one click creates a new type directly in Revit. No need to read and understand parameters, just click, move and try. Everything runs on your Revit, on your computer - nothing leaves the office. It also works in mixed reality (Quest 3): the table stands in your living room at real size, and you move its parameters right there.
Family Creator יוצר משפחה חדשה מאפס - קו: Family Creator creates a new family from scratch - a new .rfa file from a catalogue or a description. Type Studio works on a family that already exists in the project and creates new types from it by moving sliders. One creates, the other adjusts - and both save the manual parameter work.
עורך סיורי 360° חינמי: יוצרים סיור מהטלפ: A free 360° tour editor: create a tour from your phone or from the model, and show it in the browser or in a Quest headset at 1:1 scale. Room names inside the tour itself, navigation arrows so the client never gets lost, and a guided tour option - stop at any point and explain.
מעבדת המחקר והפיתוח של מוצרי המציאות המד: The research and development lab for our virtual reality products. Every object - the wand that replaces the controller in your hand, the navigation and info points, the objects that change the room - is built and tested in the lab at every size and in every state, before it goes into the tours and the products.
ל-Viewer ול-VR Tours מספיק דפדפן; החוויה: Viewer and VR Tours need only a browser; the full experience is with a Meta Quest 3 headset. DecisionMaker, Family Creator and Type Studio work together with Revit in the office - they start from your model and go back to it. No prior VR knowledge needed, we guide you.
